name: dftracer_trace
description: Collect one run's dftracer traces: per-run paths, source snapshot, the traced run (DFTRACER_* env, flux wrapper, allocation-aware), the dftracer_service daemon start/stop, flux job wait, dftracer_info summary, paper/repo configuration search; validator dftracer_trace_check (run succeeded, traces present, none zero-byte, single attempt, rank count, compacted, daemon stopped). Load at pipeline stage 4, for PRELOAD/HYBRID runs, or on zero-byte traces, 'Code 2001', missing POSIX/HDF5/MPI categories, 'DFTRACER_ENABLE: No such file or directory' under flux run, 'No running server found.', 0-byte service traces, or analysis showing 1 process / ~1542 events.

history.why: converted from dftracer-agents session_init_run/snapshot_run_source/run_with_dftracer/wait_flux_job/analyze_traces/search_papers_for_config (register_session_tools) and session_service_start/stop (register_daemon_tools), skills dftracer-preload-run and dftracer-trace-utils, agent dftracer-tracer
